OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Deployment के बाद Effect Window 3s से घटाकर 2s की गई।
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Effect Window 2s से घटाकर 1.5s और Teammate Recovery 10 से घटाकर 5 HP/s की गई।

source.label: Garena — Official Nairi full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: For a planned hold or rotation, deploy the Gloo Wall at the cover point your squad intends to use so its short restoration window begins while the team stabilizes.
Keep teammates within 5m during the brief HP-recovery window; call the regroup before spreading into separate angles.
Treat Ice Iron as a short support window, not sustained healing. Time the wall deployment around the squad's move rather than relying on repeated walls to stack recovery.
tacticalHi: Squad को किसी जगह hold या rotate करना हो, तो Gloo Wall उसी cover point पर लगाएँ जहाँ team रुकने वाली है, ताकि team के settle होते समय उसकी छोटी Recovery Window शुरू हो।
HP Recovery की छोटी Window के दौरान teammates को 5m के अंदर रखें; अलग-अलग angles पर फैलने से पहले regroup call दें।
Ice Iron को थोड़े समय के Support Effect की तरह लें, लगातार Healing की तरह नहीं। बार-बार Gloo Wall लगाकर Recovery stack होने की उम्मीद न करें; deployment का समय squad की movement के हिसाब से रखें।
strengthsEn: Adds a short durability-restoration window to deployed Gloo Walls, helping the squad maintain temporary cover.
Provides nearby teammates with a small HP-recovery window when they stay within 5m.
strengthsHi: Deployed Gloo Walls को थोड़े समय के लिए extra Durability मिलती है, जिससे squad का temporary cover बना रह सकता है।
5m के अंदर रहने वाले teammates को HP Recovery की छोटी Window मिलती है।
limitationsEn: The post-deployment effect window is only 1.5 seconds, so timing matters.
The teammate-healing effect does not stack from deploying multiple Gloo Walls.
Garena does not publish a current per-wall maximum HP recovery total for each teammate.
limitationsHi: Deployment के बाद Effect Window सिर्फ 1.5 seconds की है, इसलिए timing जरूरी है।
कई Gloo Walls लगाने से Teammate Healing Effect stack नहीं होता।
Garena, हर teammate के लिए एक Gloo Wall से मिलने वाली current maximum HP Recovery publish नहीं करता।

name: Otho
introEn: Passive ability that marks nearby enemy teammates after a knockdown and applies a short movement-speed reduction.
introHi: एक Passive Ability, जो Knockdown के बाद आसपास मौजूद एनिमी teammates को mark करती है और थोड़े समय के लिए उनकी Movement Speed कम करती है।
currentEn: After Otho knocks down an enemy, Memory Mist marks that enemy's teammates within 20m of the knocked-down enemy.
Marked enemies have their movement speed reduced by 25% for 3 seconds.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, Memory Mist marks and slows the attacker and their teammates.
currentHi: Otho के किसी एनिमी को Knockdown करने के बाद Memory Mist, Knock हुए एनिमी से 20m के अंदर मौजूद उसके teammates को mark करती है।
Mark हुए एनिमी की Movement Speed 3 seconds के लिए 25% कम हो जाती है।
अगर Otho को कोई पास का एनिमी Knockdown करता है, तो Memory Mist उस attacker और उसके teammates को mark करके उनकी Speed कम करती है।
notesEn: The 20m range is stated for the enemy-knockdown trigger. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
Garena does not publish the maximum number of players that Memory Mist can mark.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: एनिमी को Knockdown करने वाले Trigger के लिए 20m Range दी गई है। खुद Knockdown होने वाले Trigger की अलग numeric Range Garena publish नहीं करता।
Memory Mist कितने maximum players को mark कर सकती है, यह Garena publish नहीं करता।
Garena इस Passive Ability का numeric Cooldown publish नहीं करता।
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum reveal range increased from 50m to 75m; teammate information-sharing duration increased from 4s to 6s.

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist reworked: after knocking down an enemy, it marks enemies within 20m of the knocked-down enemy and slows them by 25% for 4s; when Otho is knocked down, it also marks and slows nearby enemies.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): The mark-and-slow duration changed from 4s to 3s.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Reveal Range 50m से बढ़ाकर 75m; Teammates के साथ Information Sharing Duration 4s से बढ़ाकर 6s की गई।

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist को rework किया गया: एनिमी को Knockdown करने के बाद वह Knock हुए एनिमी से 20m के अंदर मौजूद एनिमी को mark करती है और 4s के लिए उनकी Speed 25% कम करती है; Otho के Knockdown होने पर भी आसपास के एनिमी mark और slow होते हैं।
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Mark और Slow की Duration 4s से घटाकर 3s की गई।

source.label: Garena — Official Otho full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After a knockdown, use the 20m mark around the downed opponent to call the nearby enemy positions before the squad commits to a follow-up.
The 3-second slow creates a brief timing advantage: coordinate a reposition, safer angle change or reset while the marked group is slowed.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, immediately communicate the trigger so teammates know the attacker and nearby group have been marked and slowed.
tacticalHi: Knockdown के बाद down हुए opponent के आसपास 20m में mark हुए एनिमी की location call करें, फिर squad को आगे बढ़ाएँ।
3-second Slow से थोड़े समय का advantage मिलता है: इस दौरान position बदलें, बेहतर angle लें या reset करें।
अगर Otho को कोई पास का एनिमी Knockdown करता है, तो तुरंत teammates को बताएं, ताकि उन्हें पता रहे कि attacker और आसपास की team mark और slow हो चुकी है।
strengthsEn: A knockdown can reveal the downed enemy's nearby teammates, giving the squad information for its next decision.
The 25% movement-speed reduction can briefly disrupt an enemy group's reposition.
The self-knockdown trigger can also mark and slow the nearby attacker and their teammates.
strengthsHi: Knockdown से down हुए एनिमी के आसपास मौजूद teammates की location पता चल सकती है, जिससे squad अगला फैसला ले सकती है।
25% Movement Speed Reduction कुछ समय के लिए एनिमी team की repositioning बिगाड़ सकती है।
खुद Knockdown होने पर भी यह पास के attacker और उसके teammates को mark और slow कर सकती है।
limitationsEn: The main trigger requires Otho to knock down an enemy; it is not a continuous scan.
The published 20m range is measured from the knocked-down enemy. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
The mark-and-slow effect lasts only 3 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum mark count.
limitationsHi: मुख्य Trigger के लिए Otho को एनिमी Knockdown करना जरूरी है; यह लगातार चलने वाला Scan नहीं है।
बताई गई 20m Range, Knock हुए एनिमी से मापी जाती है। खुद Knockdown होने वाले Trigger की अलग numeric Range Garena publish नहीं करता।
Mark और Slow Effect सिर्फ 3 seconds रहता है और maximum mark count Garena publish नहीं करता।

name: Leon
introEn: Passive ability that restores HP after Leon survives combat.
introHi: एक Passive Ability, जो Combat से बच निकलने के बाद Leon को HP वापस देती है।
currentEn: After surviving combat, Leon recovers 60 HP at a rate of 4 HP per second for 15 seconds.
currentHi: Combat से बचने के बाद Leon 15 seconds तक हर second 4 HP की दर से कुल 60 HP recover करता है।
notesEn: The recovery begins after the game registers that Leon has survived combat.
Garena does not publish the exact combat-disengagement timer that determines when the recovery trigger begins.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Game द्वारा Leon के Combat से बच निकलने की पुष्टि करने के बाद Recovery शुरू होती है।
Recovery Trigger शुरू होने का exact Combat-disengagement timer Garena publish नहीं करता।
Garena इस Passive Ability का numeric Cooldown publish नहीं करता।
historyEn: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum recovery increased from 30 HP to 60 HP; recovery rate changed from 5 to 4 HP/s; maximum recovery duration changed from 6s to 15s.
historyHi: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum Recovery 30 HP से बढ़ाकर 60 HP की गई; Recovery Rate 5 से घटाकर 4 HP/s और Maximum Recovery Duration 6s से बढ़ाकर 15s की गई।

source.label: Garena — Official Leon full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After an engagement ends, create space behind cover and let Buzzer Beater's recovery tick before taking another contested position.
Use the recovery window to regroup with teammates and prepare the next rotation instead of treating the passive as an emergency instant heal.
Call out when you are disengaging so the squad can avoid leaving Leon isolated while the recovery is taking effect.
tacticalHi: Engagement खत्म होने के बाद cover के पीछे जगह बनाएं और दूसरी contested position लेने से पहले Buzzer Beater की Recovery होने दें।
Recovery Window का इस्तेमाल teammates के साथ regroup और अगली rotation की तैयारी के लिए करें; इसे तुरंत मिलने वाली Emergency Heal न समझें।
जब आप fight से disengage कर रहे हों तो teammates को call दें, ताकि Recovery के दौरान Leon अकेला न छूटे।
strengthsEn: Provides up to 60 HP of recovery after surviving combat without requiring a manual activation.
The 15-second recovery window can support a reset between engagements.
strengthsHi: Manual Activation के बिना Combat से बचने के बाद maximum 60 HP Recovery मिलती है।
15-second Recovery Window दो engagements के बीच reset करने में मदद कर सकती है।
limitationsEn: Recovery is gradual at 4 HP/s, not an instant HP burst.
The trigger is tied to surviving combat; Garena does not publish the exact disengagement timer.
It does not replace cover or teammate support during an active engagement.
limitationsHi: Recovery धीरे-धीरे 4 HP/s की दर से होती है, तुरंत HP नहीं मिलती।
Trigger, Combat से बचने पर निर्भर है; exact disengagement timer Garena publish नहीं करता।
Active Engagement के दौरान यह cover या teammate support की जगह नहीं लेती।

name: Koda
introEn: Active ability that activates an aurora effect, increases movement speed and periodically reveals enemies behind cover.
introHi: एक Active Ability, जो Aurora Effect चालू करती है, Movement Speed बढ़ाती है और समय-समय पर cover के पीछे मौजूद एनिमी को reveal करती है।
currentEn: Activates the Aurora power for 8 seconds and increases movement speed by 15%.
Reveals enemies behind cover within 50m every 1 second; crouching or prone enemies cannot be detected.
While parachuting, highlights enemy locations within the field of view, but the effect is not shared with teammates.
currentHi: 8 seconds के लिए Aurora Power activate होती है और Movement Speed 15% बढ़ जाती है।
हर 1 second में 50m के अंदर cover के पीछे मौजूद एनिमी reveal होते हैं; crouch या prone एनिमी detect नहीं होते।
Parachuting के दौरान Field of View में आने वाली एनिमी की locations highlight होती हैं, लेकिन यह Effect teammates के साथ share नहीं होता।
notesEn: The parachuting highlight is visible only to Koda's user.

OB54 lists two optional BR Skill Boosts, separate from the base Aurora Vision values: Synced Vision marks enemies revealed during the first detection interval for 3 seconds and shares the information with teammates; Imprinted Vision applies up to 3 stacks, with 10 additional DMG per stack when the imprints are activated by an attack.
Only one of the two Skill Boost options can be selected. OB54 did not change the base duration, movement-speed bonus, detection range or cooldown.
notesHi: Parachuting के दौरान मिलने वाला Highlight सिर्फ Koda को दिखाई देता है।

OB54 में दो optional BR Skill Boosts दिए गए हैं, जो base Aurora Vision values से अलग हैं: Synced Vision, पहले Detection Interval में reveal हुए एनिमी को 3 seconds के लिए mark करके जानकारी teammates के साथ share करता है; Imprinted Vision maximum 3 stacks लगाता है, और Attack से Imprints activate होने पर हर stack 10 extra DMG देता है।
दोनों Skill Boost options में से सिर्फ एक चुना जा सकता है। OB54 में base Duration, Movement Speed Bonus, Detection Range या Cooldown नहीं बदले गए।
historyEn: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda introduced with a 10s Aurora duration, +10% movement speed, 50m detection every 1s, a 60s cooldown, and a parachuting highlight not shared with teammates.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 15%; cooldown reduced from 60s to 45s.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora duration reduced from 10s to 8s.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Two optional BR Skill Boosts were listed again: Synced Vision (3s shared mark) and Imprinted Vision (up to 3 stacks; 10 DMG per stack when activated).
historyHi: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda को 10s Aurora Duration, +10% Movement Speed, हर 1s में 50m Detection, 60s Cooldown और teammates के साथ share न होने वाले Parachuting Highlight के साथ introduce किया गया।
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement Speed Bonus 10% से बढ़ाकर 15%; Cooldown 60s से घटाकर 45s किया गया।
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora Duration 10s से घटाकर 8s की गई।
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): दो optional BR Skill Boosts फिर से दिए गए: Synced Vision (3s Shared Mark) और Imprinted Vision (maximum 3 stacks; activate होने पर हर stack 10 DMG)।

source.label: Garena — Official Koda full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: Activate Aurora Vision before entering a contested rotation or checking likely enemy cover, then share each reveal with the squad through clear callouts.
Use the 15% movement-speed bonus to reposition with teammates while the detection window is active; do not assume every enemy will be revealed.
During parachuting, use the personal field-of-view highlights to call out visible locations because that information is not shared automatically with teammates.
tacticalHi: Contested rotation में जाने या संभावित enemy cover check करने से पहले Aurora Vision activate करें, फिर हर reveal की जानकारी squad को साफ callouts में दें।
Detection Window active रहते हुए 15% Movement Speed Bonus का इस्तेमाल teammates के साथ reposition करने में करें; यह न मानें कि हर एनिमी reveal हो जाएगा।
Parachuting के दौरान Field of View में दिखने वाली locations call करें, क्योंकि यह जानकारी अपने आप teammates के साथ share नहीं होती।
strengthsEn: Periodically reveals enemies behind cover within 50m, excluding crouching and prone targets.
Adds a 15% movement-speed bonus during the 8-second Aurora window.
Can highlight visible enemy locations during parachuting for the user.
strengthsHi: 50m के अंदर cover के पीछे मौजूद एनिमी को समय-समय पर reveal करती है; crouching और prone targets detect नहीं होते।
8-second Aurora Window के दौरान 15% Movement Speed Bonus देती है।
Parachuting के दौरान user को visible enemy locations highlight कर सकती है।
limitationsEn: The active window lasts 8 seconds and the cooldown is 45 seconds.
Crouching and prone enemies cannot be detected by the behind-cover scan.
Parachuting highlights are not shared with teammates.
OB54 Skill Boosts are optional BR enhancements and are separate from the base Aurora Vision values.
limitationsHi: Active Window 8 seconds की है और Cooldown 45 seconds है।
Behind-cover Scan से crouching और prone एनिमी detect नहीं होते।
Parachuting Highlights teammates के साथ share नहीं होते।
OB54 Skill Boosts optional BR enhancements हैं और base Aurora Vision values से अलग हैं।

name: Thiva
introEn: Passive support ability that speeds up teammate help-ups and restores HP to the teammate who is successfully helped up.
introHi: एक Passive Support Ability, जो teammates को help up करने की Speed बढ़ाती है और सफलतापूर्वक help up हुए teammate को HP वापस देती है।
currentEn: The speed of helping up teammates is increased by 70%.
After a successful help-up, the helped-up teammate recovers 60 HP over 3 seconds.
currentHi: Teammates को help up करने की Speed 70% बढ़ जाती है।
सफल Help-up के बाद उस teammate को 3 seconds में 60 HP वापस मिलती है।
notesEn: The HP recovery is applied to the teammate who was successfully helped up.
notesHi: HP Recovery उसी teammate को मिलती है जिसे सफलतापूर्वक help up किया गया हो।
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum help-up speed increased from 25% to 30%; HP recovery after a successful rescue increased from 40 HP to 50 HP over 5s.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes reworked to +70% help-up speed, 60s cooldown and 100 HP recovered by the helped-up teammate over 3s.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown increased from 60s to 90s; helped-up teammate recovery reduced from 100 HP to 60 HP over 3s.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Help-up Speed 25% से बढ़ाकर 30%; सफल Rescue के बाद HP Recovery 40 HP से बढ़ाकर 5s में 50 HP की गई।
OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes को rework करके +70% Help-up Speed, 60s Cooldown और help-up हुए teammate को 3s में 100 HP Recovery दी गई।
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown 60s से बढ़ाकर 90s; help-up हुए teammate की Recovery 3s में 100 HP से घटाकर 60 HP की गई।

source.label: Garena — Official Thiva full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: Prioritize a safe help-up behind cover when a teammate is downed; Thiva's 70% faster help-up speed shortens the time the squad must stay committed to the rescue.
After a successful help-up, keep the rescued teammate with the squad while the 60 HP recovery is applied over 3 seconds.
Track the 90-second cooldown and coordinate the next rescue window rather than assuming Vital Vibes is always available.
tacticalHi: Teammate Knockdown होने पर cover के पीछे सुरक्षित Help-up को priority दें; Thiva की 70% faster Help-up Speed से Rescue के दौरान squad को कम समय तक exposed रहना पड़ता है।
Successful Help-up के बाद rescued teammate को squad के साथ रखें, ताकि उसे 3 seconds में मिलने वाली 60 HP Recovery का फायदा मिल सके।
90-second Cooldown का ध्यान रखें और अगली Rescue Window coordinate करें; Vital Vibes को हर समय available न मानें।
strengthsEn: Increases teammate help-up speed by 70%, reducing the time needed to complete a rescue.
The successfully helped-up teammate receives 60 HP over 3 seconds.
strengthsHi: Teammate Help-up Speed 70% बढ़ाती है, जिससे Rescue पूरा करने में कम समय लगता है।
सफलतापूर्वक help up हुए teammate को 3 seconds में 60 HP मिलती है।
limitationsEn: The ability has a 90-second cooldown.
The 60 HP recovery applies only after a successful help-up.
It does not provide a direct benefit while all teammates are already standing.
limitationsHi: इस Ability का Cooldown 90 seconds है।
60 HP Recovery सिर्फ successful Help-up के बाद मिलती है।
जब सभी teammates पहले से खड़े हों, तब यह सीधा कोई फायदा नहीं देती।

name: Dimitri
introEn: Active healing zone that restores HP to Dimitri and nearby allies, and automatically starts self-recovery for downed players inside it.
introHi: Active healing zone jo Dimitri aur paas ke teammates ki HP recover karta hai, aur zone ke andar knockdown player ka self-recovery automatically start karta hai.
currentEn: Creates a healing zone with a 3.5m radius.
Dimitri and allies inside the zone recover 10 HP per second.
When Dimitri or an ally is downed inside the zone, self-recovery automatically starts when needed.
The zone lasts 12 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
currentHi: 3.5m radius ka healing zone banta hai.
Zone ke andar Dimitri aur teammates ko har second 10 HP recover hoti hai.
Zone ke andar Dimitri ya teammate knockdown ho, toh zaroorat padne par self-recovery automatically start hota hai.
Zone 12 seconds tak rehta hai. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
notesEn: OB40 states that the help-up effect can be enhanced by other skills.
During self-recovery, players can move and no longer lose HP (OB34).
Garena does not publish a separate maximum number of self-recovery activations within one zone.
notesHi: OB40 ke mutabik, help-up effect ko doosri skills se enhance kiya ja sakta hai.
Self-recovery ke dauran player move kar sakta hai aur HP lose nahi hoti (OB34).
Garena ek zone ke andar self-recovery kitni baar activate ho sakta hai, iska maximum number publish nahi karta.
historyEn: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Introduced Healing Heartbeat — 3.5m healing zone, 3 HP/s, up to 15s duration and 60s cooldown at maximum level; downed users and allies could self-recover.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery was improved so players could move during it without losing HP.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP recovery increased from 3 to 5 HP/s.
OB40 (30 May 2023): HP recovery increased from 5 to 10 HP/s; downed players inside the zone automatically began self-recovery when needed; zone duration became 12s and cooldown was 60s.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown increased from 60s to 90s.
historyHi: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Healing Heartbeat introduce hua — 3.5m healing zone, 3 HP/s, maximum level par 15s duration aur 60s cooldown; knockdown Dimitri aur teammates self-recover kar sakte the.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery update hua; ab player recovery ke dauran move kar sakta tha aur HP lose nahi hoti thi.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP recovery 3 se 5 HP/s hui.
OB40 (30 May 2023): HP recovery 5 se 10 HP/s hui; zone ke andar knockdown players ka self-recovery zaroorat padne par automatically start hua; zone duration 12s aur cooldown 60s hua.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown 60s se 90s hua.

hiddenMechanics.text: While self-recovering, the player can move and no longer loses HP (OB34).

tacticalEn: Call the healing zone before regrouping so nearby teammates know where its support area is centered.
If a teammate is downed inside the zone, communicate that self-recovery may start automatically; do not assume the area is safe from interruption.
tacticalHi: Regroup karne se pehle healing zone ki location call karo, taaki teammates ko support area ka clear idea rahe.
Zone ke andar teammate knockdown ho, toh communicate karo ki self-recovery automatically start ho sakta hai; area ko automatically safe assume mat karo.
strengthsEn: Provides HP recovery to Dimitri and nearby allies during the active zone.
Can automatically start self-recovery for downed players inside the zone.
strengthsHi: Active zone ke dauran Dimitri aur nearby teammates ko HP recovery milti hai.
Zone ke andar downed player ka self-recovery automatically start ho sakta hai.
limitationsEn: The support area is limited to a 3.5m radius and lasts 12 seconds.
The 90-second cooldown means the zone is not continuously available.
limitationsHi: Support area ka radius 3.5m hai aur zone 12 seconds tak rehta hai.
90-second cooldown ki wajah se zone continuously available nahi hota.

name: Skyler
introEn: Active sonic-wave skill that damages Gloo Walls in an area and can store up to two charges.
introHi: Active sonic-wave skill jo area mein Gloo Walls ko damage karti hai aur maximum 2 charges store kar sakti hai.
currentEn: Unleashes a sonic wave forward; OB55 states that the actual skill-effect range is over 100m, but does not publish an exact distance.
When the wave hits an obstacle, it explodes and deals 500 DMG per second to Gloo Walls within a 4m radius.
The damage effect lasts 6 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Up to 2 skill charges can be stored.
HP recovery is not included in the current base-skill values used here; the OB38 rework removed Skyler's healing effect.
currentHi: Aage sonic wave release hoti hai; OB55 ke mutabik actual skill-effect range 100m se zyada hai, lekin exact distance publish nahi ki gayi.
Wave kisi obstacle se hit hone par explode hoti hai aur 4m radius ke andar Gloo Walls ko har second 500 DMG deti hai.
Damage effect 6 seconds tak rehta hai. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Maximum 2 skill charges store ho sakti hain.
Current base-skill values mein HP recovery include nahi hai; OB38 rework mein Skyler ka healing effect remove kiya gaya tha.
notesEn: OB55 says the skill-effect visibility was extended to match the actual range of over 100m. Garena does not publish the exact range.

OB54 introduced two optional BR Skill Boosts: Sticky Rhythm creates a small area that follows the nearest enemy and damages Gloo Walls inside it; Split Rhythm searches for Gloo Walls within 75m, locks onto target walls for 15s and sends waves toward up to 3 walls. Exact damage values for these boosts are not published.
Only one Skill Boost option can be selected for the skill in a match.
OB47 added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls; OB49 added an obstacle indicator to the aiming line.
notesHi: OB55 mein skill-effect ki visibility ko actual 100m se zyada range ke saath match kiya gaya. Garena exact range publish nahi karta.

OB54 mein 2 optional BR Skill Boosts aaye: Sticky Rhythm ek chhota area banata hai jo nearest enemy ko follow karta hai aur uske andar ki Gloo Walls ko damage karta hai; Split Rhythm 75m ke andar Gloo Walls search karta hai, target walls ko 15s lock karta hai aur maximum 3 walls ki taraf waves bhejta hai. In boosts ka exact damage Garena publish nahi karta.
Ek match mein is skill ke liye sirf ek Skill Boost option select kiya ja sakta hai.
OB47 mein Gloo Walls ki taraf aim assistance add hui; OB49 mein aiming line par obstacle indicator add hua.
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): At maximum level, cooldown increased from 40s to 60s; each deployed Gloo Wall granted HP recovery, up to 9 points, and recovery effects did not stack.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Reworked into area damage over time; maximum wave range 100m, 3.5m damage radius, 4s duration and 50s cooldown. HP recovery was removed.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage radius increased from 3.5m to 4m; duration increased from 4s to 5s; cooldown reduced from 50s to 45s.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration increased from 5s to 6s; cooldown reduced from 45s to 40s.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Added up to 2 stored charges; published values were 500 DMG/s within 4m for 6s, with a 45s cooldown and up to 100m wave range.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Added an obstacle indicator to the skill's aiming line.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Added optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm and Split Rhythm.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Extended skill-effect visibility to match the actual range of over 100m; the exact range was not published.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Maximum level par cooldown 40s se 60s hua; har deployed Gloo Wall par maximum 9 points tak HP recovery milti thi aur recovery stack nahi hoti thi.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Skill ko area damage-over-time effect mein rework kiya gaya; maximum wave range 100m, 3.5m damage radius, 4s duration aur 50s cooldown hua. HP recovery remove hui.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage radius 3.5m se 4m, duration 4s se 5s aur cooldown 50s se 45s hua.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration 5s se 6s aur cooldown 45s se 40s hua.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Maximum 2 stored charges add hui; published values 4m ke andar 500 DMG/s, 6s duration, 45s cooldown aur maximum 100m wave range the.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Gloo Walls ki taraf aim assistance add hui.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Skill ki aiming line par obstacle indicator add hua.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm aur Split Rhythm add hue.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Skill-effect visibility ko actual 100m se zyada range ke saath match kiya gaya; exact range publish nahi hui.

hiddenMechanics.text: Riptide Rhythm receives aim assistance toward Gloo Walls (OB47).
An obstacle indicator appears on the aiming line (OB49).

tacticalEn: Communicate the intended route before relying on a Gloo Wall interaction; teammates should know which area is being affected.
Treat the exact wave range as unpublished: OB55 confirms it is over 100m but gives no precise distance.
tacticalHi: Gloo Wall interaction par rely karne se pehle intended route communicate karo; teammates ko pata hona chahiye ki kaunsa area affect ho raha hai.
Wave ki exact range ko unpublished hi samjho: OB55 100m se zyada confirm karta hai, lekin precise distance nahi deta.
strengthsEn: The sonic-wave effect can affect Gloo Walls within a 4m radius for 6 seconds.
The skill can store up to two charges.
strengthsHi: Sonic-wave effect 4m radius ke andar Gloo Walls ko 6 seconds tak affect karta hai.
Skill maximum 2 charges store kar sakti hai.
limitationsEn: The exact actual range above 100m is not published by Garena.
The skill has a 45-second cooldown; stored charges do not make it continuously available.
limitationsHi: 100m se zyada actual range ka exact number Garena publish nahi karta.
Skill ka cooldown 45 seconds hai; stored charges ka matlab continuous availability nahi hai.

name: Xayne
introEn: Active skill that grants temporary Shield Points, which refill and refresh the skill duration when Xayne knocks down an enemy.
introHi: Active skill jo temporary Shield Points deti hai; Xayne enemy ko knockdown kare toh shield refill hota hai aur skill ka timer reset hota hai.
currentEn: Enters the Xtreme state and instantly gains 70 temporary Shield Points for 15 seconds.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the temporary Shield Points from this skill back to 70 and resets the state duration.
When the state ends, the Shield Points gained through this skill are removed. Cooldown: 75 seconds.
currentHi: Xtreme state activate hoti hai aur turant 70 temporary Shield Points milte hain, jo 15 seconds tak rehte hain.
State ke dauran har enemy knockdown par is skill ke temporary Shield Points wapas 70 ho jaate hain aur state ka timer reset hota hai.
State khatam hote hi is skill se mile Shield Points remove ho jaate hain. Cooldown: 75 seconds.

rows.value: Garena does not publish this value

notesEn: The temporary Shield Points from Xtreme Encounter are removed when the state ends; they are not permanent HP.
Each enemy knockdown during the active state restores this skill's temporary Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
Garena does not publish a maximum number of duration refreshes.
notesHi: Xtreme Encounter ke temporary Shield Points state khatam hone par remove ho jaate hain; yeh permanent HP nahi hain.
Active state ke dauran har enemy knockdown par is skill ke temporary Shield Points 70 ho jaate hain aur duration reset hoti hai.
Garena duration kitni baar maximum refresh ho sakti hai, yeh publish nahi karta.
historyEn: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): Introduced with 80 temporary HP, up to 100% increased damage to Gloo Walls and shields, 10s duration and 100s cooldown at maximum level.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 100% to 130%; duration increased from 10s to 15s. Maximum cooldown remained 100s.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP increased from 80 to 120; maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 130% to 200%; duration reduced from 15s to 6s.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Reworked from temporary HP to 60 temporary Shield Points for 12s; each enemy knockdown restored the shield to 60 and reset duration; cooldown became 75s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points reduced from 60 to 50; duration remained 12s and cooldown remained 75s.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points increased from 50 to 70 and duration increased from 12s to 15s; cooldown remained 75s.
historyHi: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): 80 temporary HP, maximum level par Gloo Walls aur shields ko 100% extra damage, 10s duration aur 100s cooldown ke saath introduce hui.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus 100% se 130% hua; duration 10s se 15s hui. Maximum cooldown 100s hi raha.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP 80 se 120 hui; maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus 130% se 200% hua; duration 15s se 6s hui.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Temporary HP ki jagah 12s ke liye 60 temporary Shield Points mile; har enemy knockdown par shield 60 tak refill hota aur duration reset hoti; cooldown 75s hua.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points 60 se 50 hue; duration 12s aur cooldown 75s hi rahe.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points 50 se 70 hue aur duration 12s se 15s hui; cooldown 75s hi raha.
tacticalEn: Tell teammates when the temporary Shield Point state begins and when it expires so they do not mistake it for permanent protection.
A knockdown during the active state refreshes the Shield Points and duration; the profile does not assume a maximum refresh count.
tacticalHi: Temporary Shield Point state kab start aur expire hoti hai, teammates ko communicate karo; ise permanent protection mat samjho.
Active state ke dauran knockdown hone par Shield Points aur duration refresh hote hain; profile koi maximum refresh count assume nahi karti.
strengthsEn: Grants 70 temporary Shield Points for a 15-second state.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the skill's Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
strengthsHi: 15-second state ke liye 70 temporary Shield Points milte hain.
State ke dauran har enemy knockdown par skill ke Shield Points 70 ho jaate hain aur duration reset hoti hai.
limitationsEn: Shield Points gained from the skill are removed when the state ends.
The cooldown is 75 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum refresh count.
limitationsHi: Skill se mile Shield Points state khatam hone par remove ho jaate hain.
Cooldown 75 seconds hai, aur Garena maximum refresh count publish nahi karta.

name: Lila
introEn: Passive that decelerates enemies and vehicles shot with rifles, freezing them and generating Gloo Walls upon knockdown.
introHi: Rifle aur marksman rifle se hit hue enemies ko slow karti hai. Slow enemy knock ho to freeze hota hai aur extra Gloo Walls milti hain.
currentEn: When hitting enemies or vehicles with rifles or marksman rifles, reduces the enemies' movement speed by 10% or the vehicles' acceleration by 80% for 3 seconds. If the enemy is knocked down while decelerated, freezes them for up to 3 seconds and obtains 2 extra Gloo Walls.
currentHi: Rifle ya marksman rifle se enemy/vehicle hit karne par enemy ki movement speed 10% ya vehicle acceleration 80% tak 3 seconds reduce hoti hai. Slow state mein enemy knock ho, to woh up to 3 seconds freeze hota hai aur 2 extra Gloo Walls milti hain.
notesEn: The OB47 patch removed the original 10-second cooldown, making the skill continuously active upon landing successful rifle shots.
notesHi: OB47 update ne original 10-second cooldown remove kar diya tha; successful rifle hits par ability continuously trigger ho sakti hai.
historyEn: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduced. OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle decel 50% to 80%, removed 10s skill cooldown. OB49 (21 May 2025): Gloo Wall reward upon knock increased from 1 to 2.
historyHi: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduced. OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle deceleration 50% se 80%, 10s cooldown removed. OB49 (21 May 2025): Knock par Gloo Wall reward 1 se 2 hua.
tacticalEn: Use rifle hits to slow a moving enemy before your squad commits; a knock while slowed grants extra Gloo Walls for the next cover/rotation.
tacticalHi: Squad engage karne se pehle rifle hits se moving enemy ko slow karo; slow state mein knock milne par extra Gloo Walls next cover/rotation ke kaam aati hain.
strengthsEn: Repeated rifle hits can apply the slow without a cooldown; knockdown reward supports cover economy.
strengthsHi: Rifle hits par slow repeat ho sakta hai aur cooldown nahi; knockdown reward cover ke liye Gloo Wall economy improve karta hai.
limitationsEn: The freeze and Gloo Wall reward require a knock while the target is decelerated; the slow alone does not guarantee either.
limitationsHi: Freeze aur extra Gloo Wall ke liye target ko decelerated state mein knock karna zaroori hai; sirf slow se reward guaranteed nahi.

name: Maro
introEn: Passive that scales weapon damage based on the distance to the target and deals extra damage to marked enemies.
introHi: Target se distance badhne par weapon damage increase hota hai, aur marked enemies par extra damage milta hai.
currentEn: Damage increases with distance, up to a maximum of 20%. Damage to marked enemies increases by 5%.
currentHi: Target se distance badhne par damage increase hota hai, maximum 20% tak. Marked enemies ko damage 5% increase hota hai.
notesEn: Highly synergistic with information-gathering characters like Moco and Shirou.
notesHi: Moco aur Shirou jaise information-gathering characters ke saath strong synergy hai.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): Damage to marked enemies increased from 3.5% to 5%. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum distance damage bonus nerfed from 25% to 20%.
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): Marked enemies par damage 3.5% se 5% hua. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum distance damage bonus 25% se 20% nerf hua.
tacticalEn: Pair with teammate information marks; maintain distance when the engagement allows to benefit from the distance-scaled bonus.
tacticalHi: Teammate ke enemy marks ke saath pair karo; engagement allow kare to distance maintain karke distance-based bonus ka benefit lo.
strengthsEn: Combines distance scaling with a separate marked-target bonus; passive has no cooldown.
strengthsHi: Distance scaling ke saath marked target par separate bonus milta hai; passive ka cooldown nahi.
limitationsEn: The maximum distance bonus scales with range and is not the full 20% at every distance; close-range fights reduce its value.
limitationsHi: Distance bonus range ke saath scale hota hai; har distance par full 20% nahi milta. Close-range fights mein iska value kam hota hai.

name: Shirou
introEn: Passive that marks attackers who hit the user and grants massive armor penetration on the first retaliatory shot.
introHi: Jo enemy tumhe hit karta hai usko mark karta hai aur marked enemy par first retaliatory shot ko extra armor penetration deta hai.
currentEn: When hit by an enemy from within 100m, the attacker is marked for 8 seconds. Intel is shared with teammates. The first shot on marked enemies has 100% additional armor penetration. Maximum of 4 markings active at once.
currentHi: 100m ke andar enemy hit kare to attacker 8 seconds ke liye mark hota hai. Mark ki intel teammates ke saath share hoti hai. Marked enemy par first shot ko 100% additional armor penetration milti hai. Ek waqt mein maximum 4 marks active ho sakte hain.

rows.value: Garena does not publish current cooldown

notesEn: The mark is universally visible to all teammates. Garena has not republished the cooldown value since it was reduced to 10 seconds in OB36.
notesHi: Mark sab teammates ko visible hota hai. OB36 mein cooldown 10 seconds hua tha; Garena ne current cooldown ko recent profile par republish nahi kiya.
historyEn: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m to 100m, Armor pen to 100%, Cooldown 25s to 10s. OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Marking duration 10s to 8s, Max markings explicitly capped at 4.
historyHi: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m se 100m, armor penetration 100%, cooldown 25s se 10s. OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Mark duration 10s se 8s aur max active marks 4 cap.
tacticalEn: When your squad is hit, use the shared mark to call the attacker's location and coordinate a response; the first shot receives the penetration bonus.
tacticalHi: Squad hit ho to shared mark se attacker ki location call karo aur response coordinate karo; first shot ko penetration bonus milta hai.
strengthsEn: Attacker information is shared teamwide; the first retaliatory shot gains 100% additional armor penetration.
strengthsHi: Attacker ki information teamwide share hoti hai; first retaliatory shot ko 100% additional armor penetration milti hai.
limitationsEn: Marking requires Shirou to be hit by an enemy within range; it is reactive, not a proactive scan.
limitationsHi: Mark trigger hone ke liye range ke andar enemy ka Shirou ko hit karna zaroori hai; yeh reactive ability hai, proactive scan nahi.

name: Chrono
introEn: Active ability that creates an impenetrable static force field blocking incoming and outgoing damage.
introHi: Active ability ek force field banati hai jo incoming aur outgoing damage block karta hai.
currentEn: Creates an impenetrable force field that blocks 1,000 damage. Unable to attack outside enemies from within the field. All effects last for 10 seconds.
currentHi: 1,000 damage tak force field block karta hai. Field ke andar se bahar ke enemies par attack nahi kar sakte. Effects 10 seconds tak rehte hain.
notesEn: The shield blocks damage from all sources, both inside and out. Enemies can enter the shield dome.
notesHi: Shield dono taraf se sabhi sources ka damage block karta hai. Enemies dome ke andar enter kar sakte hain.
historyEn: OB31 (Dec 2021): Removed ability to shoot outward, duration 6s, cooldown 120s. OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s to 8s. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s to 45s, Shield HP 800 to 1000, Duration 8s to 10s.
historyHi: OB31 (Dec 2021): Bahar shoot karna remove hua, duration 6s aur cooldown 120s. OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s se 8s. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s se 45s, shield HP 800 se 1000, duration 8s se 10s.
tacticalEn: Use the field to create a temporary protected space for a reset or revive; remember enemies can enter the dome and you cannot shoot outward.
tacticalHi: Reset ya revive ke liye temporary protected space banao; yaad rahe enemies dome ke andar aa sakte hain aur tum field se bahar shoot nahi kar sakte.
strengthsEn: Blocks up to 1,000 damage and provides a temporary defensive window.
strengthsHi: 1,000 damage tak block karta hai aur temporary defensive window deta hai.
limitationsEn: The field is static, enemies can enter, and outward attacks are disabled while inside.
limitationsHi: Field static hai, enemies andar aa sakte hain, aur andar se bahar attack disabled hai.

name: Dasha
introEn: Passive that rewards knockdowns with a rapidly decaying rate of fire and movement speed boost.
introHi: Knockdown ke baad Highlight mode activate hota hai, jisme rate of fire aur movement speed boost milta hai jo time ke saath decay hota hai.
currentEn: After knocking down an enemy, enter Highlight mode for 10 seconds. Increases rate of fire by 18% and movement speed by 12% (decays quickly). Consecutively knocking down enemies resets the countdown and further boosts rate of fire by 4% and movement speed by 3%.
currentHi: Enemy knock karne ke baad 10 seconds ke Highlight mode mein enter hoti hai. Rate of fire 18% aur movement speed 12% increase hoti hai (jaldi decay hoti hai). Consecutive knockdowns countdown reset karte hain aur rate of fire +4%, movement speed +3% further boost karte hain.
notesEn: Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it.
notesHi: Movement speed ka global maximum hai; skills, items aur event bonuses us cap se upar nahi ja sakte.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill entirely reworked to Highlight mode (18% RoF, 12% Spd, 6s duration). OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration buffed from 6s to 10s.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill Highlight mode mein rework hui (18% RoF, 12% Spd, 6s duration). OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration 6s se 10s buff hui.
tacticalEn: After a knock, use the Highlight window to reposition or continue pressure; chained knockdowns refresh the timer and increase both bonuses.
tacticalHi: Knock ke baad Highlight window mein reposition ya pressure continue karo; chain knockdowns timer refresh karte aur dono bonuses badhate hain.
strengthsEn: Knockdown-triggered momentum can be chained; no cooldown listed.
strengthsHi: Knockdown ke baad momentum chain kiya ja sakta hai; cooldown listed nahi.
limitationsEn: Highlight requires a knockdown to start; its bonuses decay quickly and movement speed remains subject to the global cap.
limitationsHi: Highlight start karne ke liye knockdown chahiye; bonuses jaldi decay hote hain aur movement speed global cap ke under rahti hai.

name: D-BEE
introEn: A passive ability that boosts movement speed and accuracy while firing on the move.
introHi: Bullet Beats ek passive ability hai. Match mein move karte hue fire karne par movement speed aur accuracy dono boost hote hain.
currentEn: While firing and moving at the same time, movement speed increases by 50% and accuracy increases by 60%.
currentHi: Jab character move karte hue fire karta hai, movement speed 50% increase hoti hai aur accuracy 60% increase hoti hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The bonus requires movement and firing to happen simultaneously; standing still while firing does not meet the stated trigger.
The official character page gives a short description; the numerical values are documented in Garena's OB46 patch notes.
No separate duration or cooldown is published in the official sources checked.
notesHi: Bonus tabhi apply hota hai jab movement aur firing ek saath ho; sirf khade hokar fire karne se stated trigger complete nahi hota.
Official character page short description deta hai; exact numerical values Garena ke OB46 patch notes mein documented hain.
Checked official sources mein separate duration ya cooldown publish nahi kiya gaya.
historyEn: OB28 (Jun 2021): D-Bee introduced with Bullet Beats.
OB35 (20 Jul 2022): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 20%; accuracy increased from 20% to 45%.
OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement-speed bonus increased from 30% to 50%; accuracy set to 60%.
historyHi: OB28 (Jun 2021): D-Bee aur Bullet Beats introduce hue.
OB35 (20 Jul 2022): Movement-speed bonus 10% se 20% aur accuracy 20% se 45% hui.
OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement-speed bonus 30% se 50% aur accuracy 60% ki gayi.
subtitle: OB55 values reconciled 15 Nov 2026
tacticalEn: The effect is conditional on simultaneous movement and firing; it does not provide the stated bonuses while stationary.
In squad play, communicate when you are repositioning so teammates can maintain shared awareness of your movement.
tacticalHi: Is ability ka bonus tabhi milta hai jab movement aur firing saath ho; stationary rehne par stated bonus apply nahi hota.
Squad play mein reposition karte waqt teammates ko call do, taaki sabko tumhari movement aur spacing ka clear idea rahe.
strengthsEn: Provides two simultaneous passive bonuses under its stated trigger.
No active-skill activation input is required.
strengthsHi: Stated trigger complete hone par do passive bonuses ek saath milte hain.
Iske liye alag se active-skill button press nahi karna padta.
limitationsEn: The effect is conditional and does not apply when the character is stationary.
The official sources checked do not specify a separate duration or cooldown.
limitationsHi: Effect conditional hai; character stationary ho toh yeh apply nahi hota.
Checked official sources separate duration ya cooldown specify nahi karte.

name: LUQUETA
introEn: A passive ability that permanently raises maximum Shield Points with each elimination, up to a capped bonus.
introHi: Hat Trick ek passive ability hai. Har elimination par maximum Shield Points permanently badhte hain, lekin iska total bonus ek fixed cap tak hi jaata hai.
currentEn: Each elimination increases maximum Shield Points by 15. The bonus stacks up to 45 Shield Points in total and is cleared when the player is eliminated or the round resets.
currentHi: Har elimination par maximum Shield Points 15 badhte hain. Bonus stack hokar maximum 45 Shield Points tak pahunch sakta hai. Player eliminate hone ya round reset hone par yeh bonus clear ho jaata hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The bonus affects maximum Shield Points, not ordinary HP.
The effect is personal to the player using Luqueta; it is not described as a squad-wide reward.
Garena's OB49 notes confirm the current +15 per elimination and +45 maximum.
notesHi: Yeh bonus maximum Shield Points ko increase karta hai, normal HP ko nahi.
Effect Luqueta use karne wale player ka personal bonus hai; official description ise poori squad ka shared reward nahi batati.
Garena ke OB49 notes current +15 per elimination aur +45 maximum confirm karte hain.
historyEn: OB23 (29 Jul 2020): Hat Trick introduced as a maximum-HP increase per elimination, capped at 35.
OB46 (1 Sep 2024): The HP bonus was converted to Shield Points; +25 per elimination, up to +50.
OB48 (Feb 2025): The per-elimination and maximum values were reduced to +20 and +40.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum stacks increased to 3; +15 per elimination and +45 maximum.
historyHi: OB23 (29 Jul 2020): Hat Trick introduce hui; har elimination par maximum HP badhta tha, cap 35 tha.
OB46 (1 Sep 2024): HP bonus ko Shield Points mein convert kiya gaya; har elimination par +25, maximum +50.
OB48 (Feb 2025): Per-elimination aur maximum values +20 aur +40 ki gayi.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum stacks 3 hue; har elimination par +15 aur maximum +45 hua.

source.label: Garena — OB46 Patch Notes (Shield Points conversion)

subtitle: OB55 values reconciled 15 Nov 2026
tacticalEn: The passive bonus builds only from the user's own eliminations and remains until the stated reset condition.
Keep track of the current round state because the accumulated bonus does not carry through player elimination or a round reset.
tacticalHi: Passive bonus user ki apni eliminations se build hota hai aur stated reset condition tak bana rehta hai.
Current round state yaad rakho, kyunki player elimination ya round reset ke baad accumulated bonus carry forward nahi hota.
strengthsEn: The bonus can accumulate across up to three eliminations.
The increased maximum Shield Points remain for the rest of the round unless a reset condition occurs.
strengthsHi: Bonus maximum three eliminations tak stack ho sakta hai.
Reset condition na aaye toh increased maximum Shield Points round ke baaki time tak rehte hain.
limitationsEn: The ability needs eliminations to build value; it does not grant the full bonus at the start.
The accumulated effect is cleared on player elimination or round reset.
limitationsHi: Ability ka bonus eliminations ke saath build hota hai; match/round ke start par full bonus nahi milta.
Player eliminate hone ya round reset hone par accumulated effect clear ho jaata hai.

name: KELLY
introEn: A passive ability that increases sprinting speed and activates Deadly Velocity after a sustained sprint, empowering the first shot that hits a target during its active window.
introHi: Kelly ki passive ability sprinting speed increase karti hai. 4 seconds continuous sprint ke baad Deadly Velocity activate hoti hai, jisme active window ke dauran target par lagne wali pehli shot ko extra damage milta hai.
currentEn: Sprinting speed increases by 6%. Sprint continuously for 4 seconds to activate Deadly Velocity. The effect lasts 5 seconds; the first shot that hits a target during this window deals 106% damage.
currentHi: Sprinting speed 6% increase hoti hai. Deadly Velocity activate karne ke liye 4 seconds tak continuously sprint karna hota hai. Effect 5 seconds rehta hai; is window mein target par lagne wali pehli shot 106% damage deal karti hai.

rows.value: First 1 shot that hits a target
Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The official character page specifies the sprint trigger, 5-second active window and 106% damage on the first shot that hits a target.
The profile does not publish a separate cooldown value.
OB47's awakening-system change replaced non-awakened skills with their awakened versions for all players; both character appearances remained selectable.
Garena's official localized Kelly profile also lists a 6% sprint-speed increase alongside Deadly Velocity.
notesHi: Official character page sprint trigger, 5-second active window aur first target-hit par 106% damage specify karta hai.
Profile separate cooldown value publish nahi karta.
OB47 ke awakening-system change mein non-awakened skills ko sab players ke liye awakened versions se replace kiya gaya; dono character appearances selectable rahi.
Garena ke official localized Kelly profile par Deadly Velocity ke saath 6% sprint-speed increase bhi listed hai.
historyEn: 2018: Kelly introduced with Dash.
OB20 (Feb 2020): Awakened Kelly and Deadly Velocity introduced.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Garena replaced non-awakened skills with their awakened versions for all players; Kelly's Deadly Velocity became the standard skill profile.
historyHi: 2018: Kelly, Dash ability ke saath introduce hui.
OB20 (Feb 2020): Awakened Kelly aur Deadly Velocity introduce hue.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Garena ne sab players ke liye non-awakened skills ko awakened versions se replace kiya; Deadly Velocity Kelly ka standard skill profile bana.

Garena — Kelly Awakening / OB20 historical profile

The 5-second window is limited; the enhanced effect applies only to the first shot that hits a target within that window.
tacticalHi: Activation ke liye 4 seconds ka continuous sprint zaroori hai; match start hote hi ya har chhoti movement ke baad ability automatically active nahi hoti.
5-second window limited hai; is duration mein target ko hit karne wali sirf pehli shot par enhanced effect apply hota hai.
strengthsEn: The trigger and active window are clearly defined in Garena's current profile.
The ability is passive and does not require a separate activation button.
strengthsHi: Garena ke current profile mein trigger aur active window clearly defined hain.
Yeh passive ability hai, isliye alag activation button press nahi karna padta.
limitationsEn: The effect requires a continuous sprint before activation.
Only the first shot that hits a target during the 5-second window receives the stated 106% damage effect.
limitationsHi: Activate hone se pehle continuous sprint requirement complete karni padti hai.
5-second window mein target ko hit karne wali sirf pehli shot ko stated 106% damage effect milta hai.

name: HAYATO
introEn: A passive ability that combines armor penetration and frontal damage reduction, with both effects scaling as maximum HP is lost.
introHi: Art of Blades ek passive ability hai jo maximum HP kam hone ke saath armor penetration aur frontal damage reduction dono provide karti hai.
currentEn: For every 10% decrease in maximum HP, armor penetration increases by 3.5% and frontal damage taken decreases by 2%.
currentHi: Maximum HP mein har 10% ki kami par armor penetration 3.5% increase hoti hai aur saamne se aane wale damage mein 2% reduction milta hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The two effects scale from the same maximum-HP-loss condition.

The current official character page explicitly lists 2% frontal damage reduction per 10% maximum HP loss. Garena's OB47 patch notes document the integrated armor-penetration value of 3.5% per 10% HP lost.
The earlier Bushido / Art of Blades values were changed over time; the OB47 integrated value is used for the current profile.
notesHi: Dono effects ek hi maximum-HP-loss condition ke saath scale karte hain.

Current official character page har 10% maximum HP loss par 2% frontal damage reduction confirm karta hai. Garena ke OB47 patch notes integrated armor-penetration value 3.5% per 10% HP loss batate hain.
Purane Bushido / Art of Blades values time ke saath change hue; current profile mein OB47 integrated value use ki gayi hai.
historyEn: OB35 (Jul 2022): Armor penetration was reduced from 10% to 7.5% per 10% maximum HP loss.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Armor penetration was adjusted to 5% per 13% maximum HP loss.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Awakened frontal damage reduction was reduced from 3% to 2% per 10% maximum HP loss.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Original and awakened skills were integrated; Art of Blades listed +3.5% armor penetration and 2% less frontal damage taken per 10% HP lost.
historyHi: OB35 (Jul 2022): Armor penetration 10% se 7.5% per 10% maximum HP loss hui.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Armor penetration 5% per 13% maximum HP loss adjust hui.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Awakened frontal damage reduction 3% se 2% per 10% maximum HP loss hui.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Original aur awakened skills integrate hue; Art of Blades ne har 10% HP loss par +3.5% armor penetration aur 2% frontal damage reduction list ki.

tacticalEn: The passive effect scales with lost maximum HP; its listed values are not a fixed bonus at full HP.
The frontal-reduction portion applies to incoming damage from the front, as stated by Garena.
tacticalHi: Passive effect maximum HP loss ke saath scale karta hai; full HP par listed values ka full bonus assume nahi karna chahiye.
Frontal damage reduction Garena ke description ke mutabik saamne se aane wale damage par apply hota hai.
strengthsEn: Both listed effects scale from one shared condition.
No separate active-skill activation is required.
strengthsHi: Dono listed effects ek shared condition ke saath scale karte hain.
Alag active-skill activation ki zaroorat nahi hoti.
limitationsEn: The bonus depends on maximum HP loss and is not a flat always-on value.
The damage-reduction effect is specifically described as frontal.
limitationsHi: Bonus maximum HP loss par depend karta hai; yeh flat always-on value nahi hai.
Damage-reduction effect specifically frontal direction ke liye described hai.

name: MOCO
introEn: A passive information ability that marks enemies Moco hits and shares their location with the squad for a limited time.
introHi: Enigma's Eye ek passive information ability hai. Moco jis enemy ko hit karti hai uski location kuch seconds ke liye mark hoti hai aur squad ke saath share hoti hai.
currentEn: Marks an enemy hit by Moco, exposing the target's location in the field of view and on the minimap, and sharing it with teammates for 3 seconds. If the marked enemy is moving, the location remains exposed for up to 4 seconds.
currentHi: Moco ke hit kiye enemy ki location field of view aur minimap par mark hoti hai aur teammates ke saath 3 seconds tak share hoti hai. Agar marked enemy move kar raha ho, toh uski location maximum 4 seconds tak exposed reh sakti hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The current Garena profile names the ability Enigma's Eye; Hacker's Eye is not the name shown on the current official character page.
The mark duration is 3 seconds, extending up to 4 seconds when the marked target is moving.
Garena's official page does not publish a numeric cooldown or a separate mark-range value.
notesHi: Current Garena profile par ability ka naam Enigma's Eye hai; current official character page par Hacker's Eye naam nahi diya gaya.
Mark 3 seconds rehta hai; marked target move kar raha ho toh duration maximum 4 seconds tak extend ho sakti hai.
Garena ka official page numeric cooldown ya separate mark-range value publish nahi karta.
historyEn: OB13 (Jan 2019): Moco and Enigma's Eye introduced.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Base mark duration reduced from 5s to 4s; moving-target duration reduced from 6.5s to 5.5s.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Base mark duration reduced from 4s to 3s; moving-target duration reduced from 5.5s to 4s.
historyHi: OB13 (Jan 2019): Moco aur Enigma's Eye introduce hue.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Base mark duration 5s se 4s aur moving-target duration 6.5s se 5.5s hui.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Base mark duration 4s se 3s aur moving-target duration 5.5s se 4s hui.

Longer duration tabhi milti hai jab marked target move kar raha ho; base duration 3 seconds hi hai.
strengthsEn: Shares marked-target location with teammates and the minimap.
Provides a longer mark window when the target is moving.

Target move kar raha ho toh mark window thodi longer hoti hai.

The official sources checked do not publish a separate numeric cooldown or mark range.
limitationsHi: Base mark duration 3 seconds ki short window hai.
Checked official sources separate numeric cooldown ya mark range publish nahi karte.

name: STEFFIE
introEn: Active that creates a protective graffiti area that blocks throwables, reduces bullet damage, and restores armor.
introHi: Active that creates a protective graffiti area that blocks throwables, reduces bullet damage, and restores armor.
currentEn: Creates a 4m area that completely blocks incoming throwables. Allies inside the area restore 10% armor durability every second, and ammunition damage taken from enemies is reduced by 20%. The effects do not stack.
currentHi: Creates a 4m area that completely blocks incoming throwables. Allies inside the area restore 10% armor durability every second, and ammunition damage taken from enemies is reduced by 20%. The effects do not stack.
